_comment: Cross-skill chains — when the trigger event fires, also run every skill in 'then'. Triggers are gesture names (palm_fist_lock, peace, etc.), skill names (lock_screen, screenshot_full), or 'custom:<name>' for trained custom gestures. Edit and run 'reload chains' to apply.

lock_then_pause.description: Whenever the screen is locked, also pause music.

screenshot_then_journal.description: After a screenshot, log it to the journal.
